tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “How long have you been learning English?”
B hears the question and builds the answer with have been / has been + the blue verb with -ing. Watch for or since: for + a period of time, since + a starting point.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: For + a period (two hours). Since + a starting point (Monday).

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?
